lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Non-uniform lattice of high-luminance circular clusters; primary nodes form an approximate rectangular grid in the post-branchial lateral field.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical zones of increased pixel intensity aligning with spot centroids, creating a visible matrix pattern along the mid-lateral axis.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Sharp horizontal intensity gradient running parallel to the dorsal midline, demarcated by a highlight on the superior edge and a shadow on the inferior edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Discrete, high-contrast circular blobs sparsely distributed across the dorsal fin macro-mask, with higher cluster frequency observed along the posterior margin.

other_distinctive_markers: Dense constellation of sub-pixel local maxima situated in the transitional zone between the branchial region and the lateral flank.
